excerpt: SingleStore (formerly MemSQL) is a San Francisco real-time database for apps, analytics and AI. Vector Capital took majority ownership in 2025. Pricing and alternatives.
content:
SingleStore is a distributed SQL database built to handle transactions and analytics in one engine, so applications can write data and query it in real time without copying it to a separate warehouse. It supports vector search for AI applications alongside ordinary SQL, and is offered as a managed cloud service called Helios on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud, or as self-managed software. Its website pitches it as the real-time database for AI, apps and analytics. TechTarget lists MongoDB and Couchbase among its competitors.

The company was founded as MemSQL and rebranded as SingleStore in 2020. TechCrunch has described Nikita Shamgunov, who later founded Neon, as a MemSQL founder who served as its CTO and then CEO. SingleStore is based in San Francisco and led by CEO Raj Verma. TechCrunch reported in September 2021 that it raised $80 million at a $940 million valuation. In September 2025 SingleStore agreed to a growth buyout in which private equity firm Vector Capital took majority ownership, TechTarget reported; Verma stayed as CEO and long-term investors including Dell Technologies Capital and Google Ventures stayed on. TechTarget noted that the company had recently reported 34% growth in annual recurring revenue.

SingleStore publishes prices for its cloud. A Shared workspace is free for evaluation and development, and the Standard edition for production starts at $0.99 an hour; larger editions and self-managed licences are priced on the same page or through sales.

We have not used SingleStore for this page. It brings together SingleStore's own website and the reporting linked under Sources, and says where each fact comes from. Nothing here is paid placement.

faq.q: Is SingleStore the same as MemSQL?
faq.a: Yes. MemSQL rebranded as SingleStore in 2020.
Vector Capital took majority ownership in a growth buyout announced in September 2025; CEO Raj Verma stayed on, TechTarget reported.
